name: Balsag's Sunwheel: Muzzle
desc: Blueprint for a firearm accessory that can be used to create said inscribed weapon accessory by consuming materials in the Eye of Graeae's HUD.

value.text:
When aiming, you can tap the Simulated Elemental Skill to fire off rounds of the current Elemental Type. Doing this will also switch the weapon to rounds of the next Elemental Type in this sequence:
Pyro >
Hydro >
Cryo.
Unlocked at Shadow Realm Vault Level 4 Access
